blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust — architecture positions for teams being audited, attacked, and asked to prove both.
Products enforce; architecture decides where trust dies. Zero-trust done as a purchase fails quietly; done as an architecture it changes what your auditors, insurers and attackers each find.
These theses come from controls we keep live — 41 of 41 in the reference program — and from AI estates we treat as attack surfaces in their own right.
